name: Somaliland

flag.description: Three equal horizontal stripes of green, white and red, with the Shahada in white Arabic script on the green and a black five-pointed star in the center of the white.
flag.symbolism: The Shahada, the Islamic declaration of faith, affirms the place of Islam; white stands for peace and red for the sacrifices of the struggle for independence.

hook: Somaliland is green-white-red with Arabic script on the green and a black star in the middle; Iran's red emblem sits on the white instead.
trivia: The territory was briefly independent as the State of Somaliland for five days in 1960 before uniting with Somalia.
Somaliland declared independence from Somalia in 1991 and has had its own elected governments since.
